1623 Studios presents

The Rockport Murder Mysteries
description: Join 1623 Studios for the premiere of the newest installment of its award-winning Timeline: Cape Ann documentary series, The Rockport Murder Mysteries. Based on the book Murder in Rockport, Massachusetts: Terror in a Small Town by Robert Fitzgibbon and Wayne Soini, the film explores one of Cape Ann's most haunting unsolved crimes. Learn More

A Book of Gold Thrown Open

Josh Ritter is a renowned singer, songwriter, musician, artist and best-selling author. One of today’s most thoughtful and prolific voices, he has released eleven studio albums including 2019’s widely acclaimed ˜Fever Breaks of which NPR Music praised, “He remains a hydrant of ideas while embodying an endless capacity for empathy and indignation, often within a single song.” Learn More

How did East Nash Grass follow up their 2024 International Bluegrass Music Association (IBMA) award for Best New Artist? By earning a nomination for Entertainer of the Year, IBMA’s highest honor, in 2025, and celebrating fiddler Maddie Denton’s win as Fiddler of the Year. Learn More

Dracula’s luxurious monster resort is turned upside down when an unsuspecting human stumbles into Hotel Transylvania and falls for his daughter, Mavis. Packed with laugh-out-loud comedy, lovable characters, and spooky fun, this animated family favorite is a delight for audiences of all ages. Learn More

Pre-concert talk with Matthew Heck, 2 PM
Colombian cellist Santiago Cañón-Valencia is an internationally acclaimed soloist, composer, and recording artist recognized for his expressive depth and technical brilliance. Described by The Strad as “technically flawless… totally under the skin of the composers’ idioms,” he will perform works of Debussy, Ginastera, Shostakovich, and others . Learn More

New York City’s acclaimed METTA QUINTET takes you on a powerful musical journey celebrating the centennials of two of the most influential figures in jazz history: the visionary saxophonist John Coltrane and the trailblazing trumpeter Miles Davis. Through dynamic performances and fresh artistic perspectives, this unforgettable evening explores the groundbreaking music, enduring legacy, and cultural impact of these two artists who forever changed the course of American music.  Learn More

productionTitle:
Andy Grammer

Greater Than Pt. II: A One Man Show
description: An intimate, high-energy evening with multi-platinum artist Andy Grammer. Stripped to its core, this one-man show blends acoustic performance, spoken word, storytelling, and real-time audience connection into something deeply personal and undeniably uplifting. With only a piano, a guitar, and a room full of voices, Andy turns the stage into a shared experience: moving effortlessly between chart-topping hits, new songs, and the stories behind them. Raw, funny, and fully present, it’s an invitation into the heart of the music. Learn More

A global artist in every sense of the word, Jesse Cook redefines music’s power to connect people across cultures and continents. Learn More

Speaker: Sarah Knutie
Meet iconic species like blue-footed boobies, hammerhead sharks, giant tortoises, and other amazing wildlife that call the Galápagos Islands home. Then we go on assignment with National Geographic Explorer and disease ecologist Sarah Knutie to explore the groundbreaking science of the air, land, and sea with Darwin’s finches and shark nurseries. Learn More

When their owner is away, Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and the rest of the toys come to life for an unforgettable adventure. As rivalry turns into friendship, the two unlikely heroes must work together to find their way home. Pixar’s beloved original Toy Story is a timeless family classic filled with humor, heart, and imagination. Learn More

Based in Phoenix, Arizona, the Driftwood Quintet is a chamber group dedicated to crossing genres and bending boundaries in classical music. Through the work of Driftwood’s arrangers, a performance can feature anything from orchestral masterworks or piano works to the imaginative soundtracks from the greatest video games and films. Learn More

productionTitle:

Little Miss and the Boom
description: Little Miss and the Boom brings modern vintage cabaret to life with smoky vocals and a dynamic trio, blending irresistible swing and blues with classic style, theatrical flair, and a distinctly contemporary edge. Location: Third Floor Lounge Learn More

Ekep Nkwelle is a force in today's jazz scene, with a journey from Washington, DC, to New York City. She refined her talents at Duke Ellington School of the Arts, Howard University, and The Juilliard School. Learn More

productionTitle:

A Paul Simon Tribute
description: Experience the timeless music of Paul Simon with The Clements Brothers in a captivating quartet tribute filled with soaring harmonies and exceptional musicianship. George Clements brings the music vividly to life, drawing on his experience portraying Paul Simon in the national tour of The Simon & Garfunkel Story. Learn More

description: Raised as an elf at the North Pole, Buddy travels to New York City in search of his real family—and discovers a world that could use a little more Christmas spirit. Filled with laughter, heart, and holiday cheer, Elf is a beloved comedy the whole family will enjoy. Learn More.

Jazz history is filled with stirring torch songs and ballads — brilliant expressions of suffering after love has gone awry. The jazz record shelf even contains some classic album-long explorations of melancholy. But it’s hard to find precedent in pianist Christian Sands’ new Embracing Dawn, his fifth full-length effort for Mack Avenue Records. Learn More

Over the course of his three-decade-plus career, Platinum-selling and GRAMMY-nominated singer and actor Chris Isaak has performed to sold-out crowds across the globe with his longtime band Silvertone. Learn More

Enjoy the holidays with holiday favorites, old and new, infused with a bit of jazz, swing, and rock n’ roll.  In just a short span of time, the Cape Ann Big Band has become one of the most sought-after ensembles in the North Shore. Learn More

The beloved Irish folk supergroup Lúnasa, called the “hottest Irish acoustic band on the planet” (The Irish Echo) returns for a festive holiday concert celebrating the winter solstice. Don’t miss some of the finest pickers, pipers and fiddlers in the world—Lúnasa will get your spirit (and your feet) moving! Learn More

The angelic-voiced musicians of the Vienna Boys Choir celebrate the magic of the holiday season with a delightful program of Austrian folk songs, classical masterpieces, Christmas hymns, and holiday carols. For six centuries, these young cultural ambassadors have been adored the world over for their wide range of repertoire, purity of tone, and generosity of musical spirit. Learn More

As frontman for multi-platinum-selling rock band O.A.R., Marc Roberge has performed for sold-out crowds at some of the world’s most iconic venues while helping build a remarkably devoted global fanbase. Three decades into O.A.R.’s career, the New York City-based singer/songwriter/guitarist has also developed a distinct identity as a solo performer. Learn More

One of the nation’s preeminent period orchestras, Boston's own Handel & Haydn Society presents Handel’s iconic, treasured holiday tradition in a special chamber arrangement for chamber orchestra and chorus led by Associate Conductor Ian Watson. Learn More

Tony DeSare delivers a fresh take on the Great American Songbook, blending jazz, swing, and pop with charm and virtuosity. From Sinatra to Billy Joel, plus his own award-winning songs, DeSare’s program celebrates timeless melodies and heartfelt storytelling. A dynamic evening of all your holiday favorites with one of today’s most engaging performers. Learn More

With John Roseboro
Following the release of her acclaimed debut I Need to Start a Garden and its long-awaited follow-up Seed of a Seed, Haley Heynderickx recently released What of Our Nature, a collaboration with Max García Conover. After a year of touring with Max and working on new material, she now returns to the road for a rare run of solo performances. Learn More

Take 6 celebrates the spirit of Christmas in "Spread Love At Christmas."  In their show, the group will share some phenomenal Christmas songs, like “I'll Be Home for Christmas”, “White Christmas”, and “It's the Most Wonderful Time of the Year”, as well as unique versions of the Dr. Seuss classic, "You're a Mean One, Mr. Grinch," and "The Sugarplum Dance".  In addition, you'll hear the remarkable Take 6 perennials such as, “Spread Love” and “Quiet Place!” Learn More

Christmas Caravan 2026
From Hot to the holidays: Squirrel Nut Zippers keep the 30th anniversary celebration going with their festive Christmas Caravan tour.  The Squirrel Nut Zippers return with their beloved Christmas Caravan Tour, bringing a festive blend of vintage jazz, New Orleans swing, folk traditions, and holiday spirit to audiences nationwide. Following a successful year celebrating the 30th anniversary of their platinum-certified breakthrough album Hot with a special anniversary tour, the band continues the celebration by bringing their singular musical magic to the holiday season. Learn More

productionTitle:
Good Winter with Seamus Egan
A Celtic Christmas
description: Celebrate the warmth, wonder, and storytelling spirit of the season with Good Winter: A Celtic Christmas. Acclaimed musician and composer Seamus Egan invites audiences on a richly woven holiday journey of music, song, poetry, and story, drawing on Celtic traditions that honor community, memory, and the turning of the year. Learn More

Saint-Saëns’s spectacular take on the biblical hero of legendary strength and the seductive Philistine whose beauty overpowers him returns in the Met’s larger-than-life production. Featuring a massive orchestra and chorus and some of opera’s most spellbinding tunes, this masterpiece is a feast for the eyes and ears. Learn More

productionTitle:
Liz Longley

with Special Guests The Young Fables: The Holiday Fuss Tour
description: Nashville-based singer-songwriter Liz Longley is taking her music on the road this holiday season for a very special first-ever Christmas tour. Known for her stop-you-in-your-tracks voice and deeply personal songwriting, Liz is embarking on this journey in support of her forthcoming EP, The Holiday Fuss - a collection of original songs that capture the warmth, chaos, and magic of the season. Learn More
Celebrate the season with the timeless holiday classic White Christmas. Filled with unforgettable songs, dazzling dance numbers, and festive charm, it’s a holiday tradition for all ages. Learn More

Speaker: Babak Tafreshi
From the Milky Way to meteor showers to fireflies that emerge at dusk on neighborhood streets, our eyes open a little wider at the stunning photos and videos of National Geographic Explorer Babak Tafreshi. He has spent his career documenting wildlife, humanity, and the cosmos—from dark national parks to bright urban areas—with the belief that people everywhere can connect through the shared experience of simply looking up. Learn More

Musae, America’s premier female vocal band, captivates audiences with dazzling harmonies, dynamic arrangements, and infectious energy. Having performed at leading a cappella festivals around the world and appeared on NBC’s The Sing-Off, the quintet combines exceptional vocal artistry with engaging stage presence. From pop favorites to original works, Musae delivers an unforgettable concert that showcases the power, versatility, and excitement of contemporary vocal music. Learn More

La Fanciulla del West
description: Puccini’s exhilarating drama of the Wild West returns in a new staging by Richard Jones, marking the company’s first new production of La Fanciulla del West in more than 30 years. Learn More

Award-winning British jazz vocalist Emma Smith is established as one of the most compelling voices on the international stage. With diverse experience performing everywhere from the Royal Albert Hall to the world's leading jazz clubs, she has collaborated with the likes of Michael Bublé, the Quincy Jones Orchestra, Jeff Goldblum, the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra, and jazz heavyweights including Jeremy Pelt and Wayne Escoffery. Learn More
